moshi_turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?
Lots of cafes welcome dogs, just check first. Go at a quieter time for your first visit so it's not overwhelming.
Then walk him well beforehand, so he's tired. Bring a mat and a long lasting chew so he has a job to do under the table.
Calmly take him outside for a minute, then try again. If he can't settle, keep the visit short and try again another day.
Many places put one out, but a collapsible bowl in your bag is handy. Short positive visits will teach him cafes are boring, which is the goal.
